title: Charging
lead: Charging sessions derived from the state of charge between trips, where you plug in, and what the car loses while parked.

note.title: How this is derived.
note.body: The car does not report charging. When a trip starts at a higher charge level than the previous one ended, the car was charged in between; a gain of at least {{gain}} points counts as a session. The times shown are only how long the car stood there, not how long it charged. Gaps with missing trips in the export are left out, because the change in charge level cannot be attributed then.
note.capacityMeasured: Energy per session is gained points × usable capacity. Used here: {{capacity}} kWh, estimated from your recent trips.
note.capacityNominal: Energy per session is gained points × usable capacity. Used here: {{capacity}} kWh, the nominal value from the settings (too few long trips for an estimate).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.note: Charge levels are whole percent, so single sessions are accurate to about one point.
sessions.none: No charging session found in this period: no parking window with a gain of at least {{gain}} points and complete trips around it.
sessions.socTitle: Charge level before and after charging (%)

places.title: Where you plug in
places.note: Sessions within {{radius}} m of each other count as one place, labelled with its most common address. Set what each place is and what a kWh costs there; this applies to every period and is kept in backups.
places.priceDefaultHome: Leave empty for the home electricity price from the settings.
places.priceDefaultPublic: Leave empty for the public charging price from the settings.
places.mix: On average {{price}}/kWh, {{home}} of the energy charged at home.
places.mixUsed: The costs page uses this price.
places.mixManual: The costs page currently uses a fixed home share.

recent.title: Latest sessions
recent.note: Most recent first. The last column is the time the car stood there.

standby.title: Standby drain
standby.note: Charge lost while parked without charging, for stops of at least {{hours}} hours without missing trips. It includes everything the car does on its own: climate pre-conditioning from the app, wake-ups, and security features such as a sentry-like mode.
standby.none: No parking window of at least {{hours}} hours without charging and without missing trips in this period.
standby.pctHint: total points lost per parked day
standby.medianHint: often 0: most stops lose under one point
standby.distribution: Loss per stop, by rate (% per day)

balance.title: Energy balance
balance.note: Energy used by trips against energy charged, both for the selected period.
balance.used: Used by trips (reported by the car)
balance.explain: The charged figure is battery-side: points gained × usable capacity. Charging losses (charger, cable, battery heat) happen before that point and are not measurable here, so do not read the difference as an efficiency. Sessions hidden in missing trips, standby losses and rounding make it differ from zero as well.
balance.gaps: {{gaps}} of {{total}} parking windows contain missing trips and are excluded.
